title: fix(spec): the step-18 upgrade rationale states the element data-binding ruling in words instead of a tracker id
body:
Fixes #24179

Clause-②: no

Two `STEP18_RATIONALE` fragments in `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts.template` told the upgrading author "(#11509, ruling A-narrow…)": a tracker number and a ruling letter. `os migrate meta --from 17` prints that text for the 17 → 18 hop (`packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/meta.ts:933`, `hop.rationale`), and the generated upgrade guide renders it (`packages/spec/scripts/build-upgrade-guide.ts:114`). Each parenthetical now states what was decided, with the ruling's date, in the `ruled DATE …` form the earlier step-18 sweep (`f623e2f71`) used for the rest of the list. Text only: fragment ids, orders and the other 122 fragments are byte-identical. Scope is triage's grade `6236131058`: these two strings, no new gate for `text:` fields.

Dev executor for the `domain:spec` seat 1 PM (claim `6236550221`, session `session_01TyRhWbVbbQpQJTDbW8VahJ`).

## What changed

| fragment id | before | after |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `element-flat-data-binding-retired` | "…second data door (#11509, ruling A-narrow): the flat…" | "…second data door (ruled 2026-10-08, which leaves the `object-*` blocks their native keys): the flat…" |
| `object-grid-default-filters-retired` | "…`defaultFilters` (#11509, ruling A-narrow, in the shape of the `defaultSort` retirement): the legacy…" | "…`defaultFilters` (ruled 2026-10-08 together with the element layer's flat binding keys, in the shape of the `defaultSort` retirement): the legacy…" |

**Where the words come from.** The ruling of record is comment `6051498447` on the tracker: the maintainer's 「11509 同意」 of 2026-10-08T03:20Z, letter A-narrow. In its words: the element layer's ten flat data-binding keys retire and `object-grid.defaultFilters` retires with them, while "the `object-*` block layer keeps its native keys"; sub-question 1 says `defaultFilters` "retires with a conversion in the shape `defaultSort`'s took". The first sentence already said that an element now binds through `dataSource` only, so its parenthetical carries the part it did not say: the narrowing, meaning the block layer keeps its keys. The second keeps its `defaultSort` clause and gains what the ruling joined it to. Neither parenthetical names ADR-0049: the ruling decides a synonym consolidation (one data door per element) and does not cite enforce-or-remove.

**Provenance.** The `#11509` id stays in the `//` comment at the head of each fragment's D3 entry, the file the fragment `id` names: `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.element-flat-data-binding-retired.ts:5` and `18.object-grid-default-filters-retired.ts:5`, both `// #11509 (v18, ruling A-narrow)`. **No `//` comment was added inside the list**, though the dispatch suggested one. `scripts/step18-rationale-merge.test.ts` parses the list against a fixed element shape (`id`, `order`, `text`, then the literal chain) and fails on any residue. Measured on a scratch copy with that test's own `ELEMENT` regex: a `// #11509 …` line put above the element, or between `id:` and `order:`, stops the parse at fragment 28 of 124 (`residueOk false`). The list has no `//` lines today, and the `f623e2f71` sweep added none.

**Changeset** `.changeset/24179-step18-rationale-tracker-ids.md`, `@objectstack/spec` **patch**. The text ships: after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`, `dist/migrations/index.js` and `dist/migrations/index.mjs` carry the new wording (2 files), and the old `second data door (#11509` occurs 0 times in `dist/`. Positive control: the neighbouring conversion id `action-block-endpoint-to-target` occurs in 8 `dist/` files. `protocol-upgrade-guide.md` is in `files[]` and is generated at publish. No committed generated artifact moves: `check:generated` reports all 14 up to date, and `registry.ts` is gitignored.

## Measured (tree `objectstack-ai/objectstack` at base `2bcaefba9`, head `f953eaa70`)

- **Premise.** `git grep -n '#11509, ruling A-narrow' packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts.template` at base gives 2 hits, `:1746` and `:2336`. Control: `STEP18_RATIONALE` gives 3 hits in the same file (`:41`, `:1207`, `:3319`).
- **Re-scan of every `#` followed by digits on the template's non-comment lines (base).** 6 lines. 2 are the targets. The other 4 (`:279`, `:665`, `:756`, `:910`) are `Prime Directive #12` / `PD #12` / `Prime Directive #10` in step **17**'s rationale. Those are directive numbers, not tracker ids. None is in `STEP18_RATIONALE`.
- **The parsed list, using the merge test's own parser and evaluating each literal chain.** At base: 124 fragments, 2 carry a `#` followed by digits (`element-flat-data-binding-retired` and `object-grid-default-filters-retired`, each `#11509`). At head: 124 fragments, 0 do.
- **What the author sees.** Read through the generated registry module (`MIGRATIONS_BY_MAJOR[18].rationale`, 121,772 chars), the head text has **0** `#` followed by digits. `tsx scripts/build-upgrade-guide.ts --out SCRATCH` writes a guide with 0 occurrences of `#11509`, and the new wording appears.
- **No test pins either sentence.** `git grep` for "second data door", for the old `defaultFilters` parenthetical and for `ruling A-narrow` in non-comment test lines finds nothing. The two tests that read these entries (`element-flat-binding-retirement.test.ts`, `page-component-filter-record-to-rule-array.test.ts`) assert `conversionIds` and `semantic` ids only.

## Tests and gates (all at `f953eaa70`)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`: VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Full local spec suite: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --project local --maxWorkers=2` gave **Test Files 691 passed (691), Tests 20961 passed, 1 todo**, VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Repo-project files that pin this file's shape, run locally because they are the edited file's own pins: `scripts/step18-rationale-merge.test.ts` and `src/ui/element-flat-binding-retirement.test.ts` gave **2 files, 65 tests passed**. The other 65 `repo`-project files are CI's (`Test Core`).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` (tsc, scripts typecheck and test typecheck): VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: exit 0, "All 14 generated artifacts are up to date".
- Derived gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` gave 80 commands, and `--ran` reconciliation says **80 derived, 79 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN**. 79 exited 0. `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: it needs every package's `dist`, which needs a whole-repo build), so it is **NOT MEASURED locally** and left to CI's `Lint & Repo Gates`. Four gates first exited non-zero because of how I ran them, and each was re-run green on a stable `dist`. `check:doc-formula-expressions` and `check:lean-entry-closure` first exited 3 because their prerequisite builds were missing; they passed after building `@objectstack/lint` and `@objectstack/objectql`. `check:entry-nameability` and `check:exported-any` first read a `dist` that a concurrent rebuild of mine was rewriting. All 19 derived commands that overlapped that rebuild (17 spec `check:*` gates, `check:changeset-gate-self-tests` and `check:cross-package-test-inputs`) were re-run too, all green.
- `node scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs`: exit 0. A control-byte grep over both changed files gives no hits.

## Acceptance notes

- **Observation, no card filed.** Step 17's rationale (`registry.ts.template:279`, `:665`, `:756`, `:910`) and several step-18 conversion texts in the generated guide cite `Prime Directive #12` / `#10` / `#2`. Those are AGENTS.md directive numbers, not tracker ids, so they fall outside this card's class. The text is already published, and nobody carries it.
- `origin/main` moved one commit past the base (`7d6ec91d2`, `packages/cli` only, no overlap with this diff). The branch was not merged forward; PR CI and the merge queue validate the merged tree.
- `check:doc-authoring` still does not reach `text:` fields. Per the triage grade, no gate is added.
